_about: Held-out set r5 (ARB-101), frozen 2026-10-23 before any scan. 10 repositories per language: 5 well-run (OpenSSF Scorecard >= 7.0; Ruby >= 6.0) and 5 applications (deployed services, web apps, self-hosted tools), each the top by stars among repositories with >= 1000 stars, pushed in the last 60 days, not archived/fork/template, an OSI licence, the language >= 60% of bytes (Ruby >= 50%), size <= 400000 KB, a .github/workflows directory, and not used before in Arbiter's corpora. Chosen from GitHub and Scorecard metadata, descriptions and READMEs only: nothing was cloned, scanned or read as source before the list was frozen. Each repo is pinned to its default-branch HEAD on 2026-10-23. `rejected` lists every repository above each cut-off that was skipped, with the reason, so the selection can be audited.
